images.alt: A new request leads to a convenient patch, duplicated or entangled responsibilities, harder subsequent changes and pressure for another local workaround.

Structural roles are Entity, Value Object and Enum. Behavioral roles are Operation, Query, Calculation, Rule, Policy and Workflow. Connective roles are Interface, Event and Mapping. The lifecycle role is State Machine.

Domain definitions inform a project model. Validation checks its declarations under selected architecture constraints. The compiler uses selected realizations to construct artifacts. Observations of exact targets and records of performed work are preserved in project state.

The supplied snapshot is evaluated by Within capacity. Requested units strictly below available units produce Accept. Equality or a larger request produces Reject. Both branches return without changing state.

Classify capacity is a Calculation. Its input type refers to Capacity snapshot, its condition calls Within capacity through a typed Rule reference, and its result type refers to Capacity decision. All three arrows represent typed references, not authored graph relationship kinds.

Model validation checks declarations and connections. Artifact verification checks code against its selection. Behavioral evaluation checks execution against expected outcomes. Completion review checks which required actions have evidence of performance.

Allowing equality revises the acceptance definition, Rule and expected outcomes. Reserving capacity adds a state-changing responsibility with ownership, consistency and failure contracts. Each successor needs design review and its own construction and evaluation evidence.

A session records its work in durable project state. Context views select task-relevant information, and ontology views expose recorded concepts and relationships. A later ephemeral session uses those views while maintaining only its own short-term memory.

A particular definition, model, artifact or work record can be examined for its governing meaning and permissions, its origin and evidence, and its current state and required transitions. These are independent governance questions.
